ios.desc:
Liberty Guard is an all-in-one resistance and preparedness app designed to help people stay informed, connected, and ready to respond to threats in their area. Get real-time citizen alerts, civil rights resources, protest event listings, and offline preparedness guides — everything you need to protect rights, plan actions, and stay safe.

KEY FEATURES:

REAL-TIME CITIZEN ALERTS

• Receive instant alerts on local safety threats, civic activity, and public events.
• Follow verified news and democracy updates that affect your community.
• View live threat maps and regional alert feeds curated from trusted civic sources.
• Stay one step ahead with situational awareness and actionable intelligence.

COMMUNITY & NETWORKED SAFETY

• Connect with others through community messaging to share verified updates.
• Build neighborhood networks to strengthen mutual safety and civic support.
• Coordinate peacefully and effectively during protests or emergencies.
• Encourage awareness, preparedness, and accountability across communities.

CIVIL RIGHTS & PROTEST GUIDES

• Access 35+ offline guides covering rights, protest safety, documentation, and civic readiness.
• Learn best practices for non-violent organizing, de-escalation, and first aid.
• Use the Protest Message Generator to create powerful signs and slogans by cause.
• Discover trusted organizations and legal-aid resources ready to help when needed.

EVENTS & CIVIC ENGAGEMENT

• Explore upcoming protests, marches, and community meetings near you.
• Filter by cause or region to find verified, non-partisan actions supporting democracy and justice.
• Get event updates, directions, and safety information all in one place.

EMERGENCY BEACON (SOS)

• Activate the SOS Beacon to instantly share your live location and alert trusted contacts.
• Customizable templates let you signal protest detainment, injury, or emergency situations fast.
• Designed for rapid response and maximum privacy.

DEMOCRACY HEALTH DASHBOARD

• Track five key pillars of democratic strength: Free Speech, Civil Rights, Elections, Press, and Justice.
• Visualize trends with dynamic scores updated in real time.
• Follow the implementation of Project 2025.
• Empower yourself with context behind alerts and news cycles.

PRIVACY & SECURITY BUILT IN

• AES-256 encryption and local-first architecture protect all personal data.
• No tracking, no data sales, no ads — ever.
• Every feature is designed for safety, trust, and digital independence.

WHO USES LIBERTY

quotes.text:
Hey everybody, just sharing an app designed for activists, organizers, and folks who oppose fascism. It has real-time emergency alerts, democracy health tracking, community messaging and user alerts to monitor threats in your area.

If you're involved in any kind of resistance work or just want to stay better connected with what's happening around you, it might be worth checking out:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/libertyguard/id6753902370?platform=iphone

It's built with privacy in mind (encrypted, no data collection) and is free to download with most functions available on the free version.

Stay safe out there!
